caption: A sheet of paper rests on a wire rack above a burning candle, and a brown spot forms over the flame, then a hole burns through with a glowing edge spreading outward.

sa.check: A sheet of paper rests on a wire rack above a burning candle.
A brown spot forms on the paper over the flame.
A hole opens at its centre.
The hole grows with a glowing rim.
Thin smoke rises from the spot.

pc.expect: The brown spot only darkens, the hole only grows and the paper does not turn white again.
pc.fail: The brown spot fades back to white paper; or the hole closes up; or the hole grows and shrinks in turn; or the glowing rim travels inward and the hole fills in behind it.

pc.expect: The paper chars and burns away at the hole rather than vanishing all at once, and no new paper appears.
pc.fail: The whole sheet vanishes in a single frame; or a second sheet appears; or a hole appears in a part of the paper away from the flame; or the sheet grows larger as it burns.

pc.expect: The spot and the hole form directly over the flame and the paper away from the flame stays white.
pc.fail: The spot forms at a corner of the sheet away from the flame; or the flame plays under the paper and it stays white and unmarked to the end of the clip; or the paper browns evenly all over while the flame sits under one spot.

pc.expect: The smoke rises from the spot, any charred flakes fall, and the flame points upward at the paper.
pc.fail: The smoke sinks through the rack and pools; or charred flakes rise and stay aloft; or the flame points downward away from the paper; or the smoke pours downward out of the hole.

pc.expect: One sheet on one rack over one candle; the paper stays paper as it chars and the rack stays rigid.
pc.fail: The paper melts and drips; or the paper turns into another material as it burns; or the rack's wires bend or melt; or the candle passes through the rack.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rack, the candle's holder and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The rack changes spacing; or the holder changes colour; or items around the rack rearrange.
